features.statement: The page has no h1; the heading outline starts at h2 and is not ordered to match visual order.
Layout uses semantic landmarks (header, main, aside, footer, nav, sections) once each, without article, figure or blockquote elements.
Body text is about 17px with a 1.6 line-height ratio; h2 headings are bold at roughly 22px.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width column of roughly 1080px within a wider 1440px page, with a main column plus sidebar.
Header is a white band with a green logo wordmark at left and a small dark banner image at right.
One nav item is highlighted as a solid green tab with white text and rounded top corners; other items are unstyled.
Dark textured page background contrasts with white cards, and some body text on it has low contrast and is barely legible.
Suggested-search chips appear as pale green pills after a muted label under the search field.
Content opens with a large illustrated map featuring colored circular markers and decorative display lettering.
No gradients, blur, animations or transforms are used; only CSS transitions are declared.
Filter tabs are pill-shaped, with a solid green active state and green-outlined inactive ones.
List entry cards have a thick left accent border whose color encodes the category (green or blue).
A long, dense list of entry cards makes up most of the page's vertical length.
Pagination uses square bordered numbered buttons with next/last controls and a green-filled current page.
Blue is used for links, while green is the dominant accent for logo, headings, active states and buttons against near-black text.
Sidebar card headings are paired with small green line-art illustrations at their left.
A contrasting coral call-to-action button spans the full width of its sidebar card.
Statistics appear as a 2x2 grid of tiles with large bold green numbers and small labels.
Cards pair headings and text with grainy, hand-made illustrations of illustrated scenes, signboards and silhouettes, including in the footer.
Language selector is two bordered buttons with small flag icons, with the selected one in pale green fill.
A first-person mission message ends with a bold personal sign-off.
Footer is white with two columns: social handles with small icons on the left, inline underlined links and credits on the right.
The page relies on raster images with no inline SVG.
Styling is a single embedded style block with hand-named classes, with no external stylesheets or utility frameworks.
The page is link-dense, with many anchors and spans and few paragraphs of prose.
Copy uses occasional exclamation marks in headings and calls to action, with no emoji or em dashes.
Cards share white fill, rounded corners, about 22px padding and a consistent ~24px vertical gap.
Entries are labeled with short parenthetical markers distinguishing paired variants, such as (m) and (f).
